hostingBoundary: one operator-owned Windows Docker Desktop canonical workspace

scope.coreManage: explicit --runtime-mode core-manage acquires only Core/Manage Compose configuration and ports, ingress, and immutable Core/Manage/executing Workbench/Platform sources; the exact stored scope identifies this mode without changing record fields; full/partial source vectors cannot substitute for one another; listener teardown uses acquired ports; DPM seeding requires full scope and partial startup returns before invoking it
scope.projects: explicit canonical project -> exact normalized checkout; only declared Core aliases
scope.ports: union of actual resolved app-owned Compose publications and declared host launchers 80/8001/8111
scope.sources: full checked-out consumer/provider HEAD revisions; selected Workbench path is carried unchanged through admission, operation and publication; not an image qualification or dirty-tree certificate

resourceIdentity: actual full container ID or host PID plus UTC process birth, exact checkout and published ports
acquisition: explicit holder, issue/PR purpose, UTC expiry within eight hours; live unreserved inventory needs operator handover bound to scope and inventory digests
mutation: whole-operation fence then locked durable admission before I/O; explicit operation token; reobserve and atomically publish actual inventory plus success/failure without masking native exit status
refresh: same unexpired holder/reservation/expiry and unchanged projects/ports/runtime mode; digest-reviewed lotus.canonical-runtime.refresh.v1 plan binds original scope/bindings and exact target sources/repository/service allowlists; pending change operation retains original grant; selected build occurs under existing fence; immutable prepared image IDs and repository/checkout/source labels verified before replacement; pinned up disables dependency changes/build/pull; finish verifies exact untouched bindings/images and replacement cardinality/port shapes; source-only keeps identical bindings and separately records actual runtime images; failures remain pending; explicit refresh recovery completes prepared target or aborts exact restored original; no automatic regrant or live certification
refreshInputs: service plans require composeConfigDigest binding the full evaluated Compose model before generated overrides; subsequent commands reuse that frozen model with the original project-directory and explicit empty interpolation env file; already escaped literal dollars and reviewed build metadata stay unchanged; selected build context/Dockerfile come from exact committed Git blobs, excluding ignored/untracked bytes and archive attributes; symlink/submodule entries and unresolved environment/build arguments refuse; source-only needs no Compose digest; local custody does not certify external base images/network downloads/runtime bind-mount contents
nestedConsumer: execute in-process with the exact original canonical exclusive FileStream registered by Enter to its admitted token in that module instance and holder/workspace/selected Workbench unchanged; reject absent/disposed/foreign/shared/replacement/new-process fences before preflight-operation and I/O; a persisted token alone is not admission; child neither reacquires nor finishes the caller's operation
expiry: refuse new changes; original holder may teardown; explicit named reclaim always requires handover and preserves prior history
interruption: retain unfinished operation; recovery/reclaim first prove whole-operation fence free, then require explicit holder/operator receipt bound to actual inventory
release: only admitted holder, successful teardown and zero canonical containers/listeners; failure or remaining resources retains active holder
incidentalTests: noncanonical projects not binding reserved ports remain independent and are never selected for cleanup
